title: Taiwanese American Students Club at UIUC
content_html:
The Taiwanese American Students Club (TASC) at UIUC is a registered student organization at the University of Illinois Urbana-Champaign, founded in 1991. The organization is also listed in the university’s official club directory at one.illinois.edu. Its Instagram profile confirms the 1991 founding date. TASC is dedicated to providing a community for Taiwanese American students and those interested in Taiwanese culture, and is committed to fostering a welcoming environment that promotes and educates Taiwanese culture and issues.

TASC hosts a variety of events throughout the year, including social events, cultural events, and professional development events, and collaborates with other student organizations and community partners. The organization’s signature event is an annual Night Market — the university’s official calendar notes a 12th annual edition, indicating the event has been running for well over a decade. TASC also publishes a bi-weekly newsletter called TASC Times, and its team is organized across five committees covering event planning, social media, and community partnerships.

TASC maintains a robust online presence with a dedicated website at tascuiuc.org, an Instagram account (@tascuiuc) with over 2,300 followers and nearly 600 posts, an active Facebook page, and a Linktree. The Linktree was updated as recently as January 2026, indicating continued activity.
